sections.text:
Increases the Ability Power of all allies’ dark Unison damage by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Ability Power 240. Damages all enemies 2 times with magic dark damage at success of 100 points.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
Increases ATK and MATK of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
Reduces Ability cooldown times (except certain Abilities) for all allies by 25% for 60 seconds.
If a dark Great Spirit is summoned, its Ability Power is boosted by 30.
During the Element Battle light element weakening effect increased by 5%
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
[Unison Effect Boost] Additional 10% boost to the Light and Time weakening effects with a 10% increase during Element Battles when this Unison Skill is used.
